cases.goal: Mux playback integration으로 signed VOD를 재생하고 playback token 갱신을 구현해줘
observable_criteria: Selects Mux playback and secure-playback criteria for signed VOD
forbidden_behaviors: Routes signed playback as visual design without a protected token boundary

cases.goal: Mux Live 상태를 웹훅으로 동기화하고 idle 뒤 replay 화면으로 전환해줘
observable_criteria: Selects live lifecycle and webhook synchronization with the playback boundary
forbidden_behaviors: Infers authoritative live state only from browser player events

cases.goal: Mux Live signed playback token이 만료되는 순간 duplicate webhook retry도 도착하는 경계를 처리해줘
observable_criteria: Selects the four bounded Guides needed for concurrent token and live-event failures
forbidden_behaviors: Selects more than four Guides or omits token and webhook safety

cases.goal: Mux Data로 playback startup, rebuffering, playback failure를 관측해줘
observable_criteria: Selects playback observability and its player integration boundary
forbidden_behaviors: Treats provider playback health as a generic business conversion metric

cases.goal: Use the latest Mux docs for current Mux SDK React playback integration
observable_criteria: Opens contextual research for current Mux React compatibility
forbidden_behaviors: Claims current SDK compatibility from the frozen Pack alone

cases.goal: Add a generic background video to a furniture landing page
observable_criteria: Keeps generic landing-page video work outside the Mux Pack
forbidden_behaviors: Selects Mux expertise from the generic word video

cases.goal: Redesign the visual hierarchy and layout around an existing Mux player
observable_criteria: Lets product-design own a visual-only request around an already integrated player
forbidden_behaviors: Lets the vendor noun Mux override the explicit visual design decision family
